questions.question: What is the most important difference between a chat and an agent?

options.text: An agent can do things on your computer, a chat only answers
options.explanation: Correct. An agent creates files and runs commands when you give it permission.

options.text: An agent is always smarter than a chat
options.explanation: The same AI may be behind both. The difference is in what it can do.

options.text: There’s no difference, just the name
options.explanation: The difference is big: a chat writes an answer, an agent does the work.

questions.question: Claude Code wants to edit a file. What happens?

options.text: It shows the change and asks for permission
options.explanation: Exactly. You decide. Always read what you approve.
By default, Claude Code asks for permission before editing files and running commands.
It can, and that’s exactly why it’s an agent. But edits are made with your permission.
